title: Level 11: Mystic Arcanum
text: Pick a level 6 Warlock spell to cast free once per Long Rest; more at 13, 15, 17.

title: Level 19: Epic Boon
text: Gain an Epic Boon or other qualifying feat; Boon of Fate suggested.

title: Level 20: Eldritch Master
text: Magical Cunning now restores all expended Pact Magic slots.

title: Eldritch Invocation Options
text: Intro to the alphabetical list of Eldritch Invocations.

title: Agonizing Blast
text: Add Cha mod to the damage of one damaging Warlock cantrip; repeatable (Warlock 2+).

title: Armor of Shadows
text: Self-only Mage Armor at will, no spell slot needed.

title: Ascendant Step
text: Self-only Levitate at will, no spell slot needed (Warlock 5+).

title: Devil’s Sight
text: See in Darkness, magical or not, and Dim Light as if bright, out to 120 feet (Warlock 2+).

title: Devouring Blade
text: Thirsting Blade grants two extra attacks instead of one (Warlock 12+).

title: Eldritch Mind
text: Advantage on Con saves to keep Concentration.

title: Eldritch Smite
text: Once per turn on a pact weapon hit, burn a Pact slot: extra Force d8s and knock prone.

title: Eldritch Spear
text: One damaging cantrip's range grows by 30 feet per Warlock level; repeatable (Warlock 2+).

title: Fiendish Vigor
text: Self-only False Life at will with maximum temp HP (Warlock 2+).

title: Gaze of Two Minds
text: Bonus Action: touch a willing ally to share its senses, renewable each turn (Warlock 5+).

title: Gift of the Depths
text: Breathe underwater, Swim Speed equal to Speed, free Water Breathing once per Long Rest (Warlock 5+).

title: Gift of the Protectors
text: Creatures named in your Tome drop to 1 HP instead of 0, once per Long Rest (Warlock 9+).

title: Investment of the Chain Master
text: Pact familiar gains fly or swim 40 ft, Bonus Action attacks, your save DC, and damage options.

title: Lessons of the First Ones
text: Gain one Origin feat; repeatable with a different feat (Warlock 2+).

title: Lifedrinker
text: Pact weapon hit adds 1d6 Necrotic/Psychic/Radiant once per turn; spend a Hit Die to heal.

title: Mask of Many Faces
text: Cast Disguise Self without a spell slot (Warlock 2+).

title: Master of Myriad Forms
text: Cast Alter Self without a spell slot (Warlock 5+).

title: Misty Visions
text: Cast Silent Image without a spell slot (Warlock 2+).

title: One with Shadows
text: In Dim Light or Darkness, cast Invisibility on yourself free (Warlock 5+).

title: Otherworldly Leap
text: Self-only Jump at will, no spell slot needed (Warlock 2+).

title: Pact of the Blade
text: Bonus Action: summon or bond a melee pact weapon; use Cha for attacks and change its damage type.

title: Pact of the Chain
text: Learn Find Familiar and cast it free, with special forms like Imp, Quasit, or Sprite.

title: Pact of the Tome
text: Conjure a Book of Shadows: 3 cantrips and 2 ritual spells from any list; usable as a focus.

title: Repelling Blast
text: A cantrip attack hit can push a Large or smaller target 10 feet; repeatable.

title: Thirsting Blade
text: Pact weapon gets Extra Attack: two attacks per Attack action (Warlock 5+).

title: Visions of Distant Realms
text: Cast Arcane Eye without a spell slot (Warlock 9+).

title: Whispers of the Grave
text: Speak with Dead at will, no spell slot needed (Warlock 7+).

title: Witch Sight
text: Gain Truesight out to 30 feet (Warlock 15+).

title: Warlock Spell List
text: Warlock spells listed by level with school; C = Concentration, R = Ritual, M = Material.

title: Warlock Subclass: Fiend Patron
text: Warlock subclass whose patron is a demon or devil from the Lower Planes.

title: Level 3: Dark One’s Blessing
text: Downing a foe (yours or one near you) grants temp HP of Cha mod + Warlock level.

title: Level 3: Fiend Spells
text: Gain always-prepared fiend spells at set Warlock levels, per the Fiend Spells table.

title: Fiend Spells
text: Table: Fiend spells at levels 3, 5, 7, 9 (Burning Hands, Fireball, Wall of Fire, Geas, etc.).

title: Level 6: Dark One’s Own Luck
text: Add 1d10 to an ability check or save after seeing the roll; Cha-mod uses per Long Rest.

title: Level 10: Fiendish Resilience
text: After each Short or Long Rest, choose a non-Force damage type to resist.

title: Level 14: Hurl Through Hell
text: Once per turn on a hit: Cha save or target vanishes and takes 8d10 Psychic; 1/Long Rest.

title: Wizard
text: Class heading: the Wizard, an Intelligence caster who learns spells from a spellbook.

title: Core Wizard Traits
text: Wizard basics: Int primary, d6 Hit Die, Int and Wis saves, 2 skills, simple weapons, no armor.

title: Becoming a Wizard …
text: Section on how to take the Wizard class, new or multiclassing.

title: As a Level 1 Character
text: Starting as a Wizard: take every core trait plus level 1 Wizard features.

title: Wizard Features
text: Table: proficiency bonus, features, cantrips, prepared spells and spell slots by level 1 to 20.

title: As a Multiclass Character
text: Multiclassing into Wizard: gain the Hit Die and level 1 features; see multiclass slot rules.

title: Wizard Class Features
text: Intro: Wizard features unlock by class level; see the class table.

title: Level 1: Spellcasting
text: Cast with Intelligence from a spellbook; 3 cantrips, six level 1 spells in the book, prepare daily.

title: Level 1: Ritual Adept
text: Cast any Ritual spell in your spellbook as a ritual without preparing it.

title: Level 1: Arcane Recovery
text: On a Short Rest, recover slots totaling half your Wizard level (no level 6+); 1/Long Rest.

title: Level 2: Scholar
text: Gain Expertise in one proficient scholarly skill, such as Arcana, History, Medicine, or Religion.

title: Level 3: Wizard Subclass
text: Pick your Wizard specialization at level 3, such as Evoker; also covers adding to your spellbook.

title: Level 4: Ability Score Improvement
text: Gain an ASI feat (raise ability scores) or another feat you qualify for; repeats at 8, 12, 16.

title: Level 5: Memorize Spell
text: After a Short Rest, swap one prepared level 1+ spell for another in your spellbook.

title: Level 18: Spell Mastery
text: Pick a level 1 and level 2 action spell to cast at will at base level.

title: Level 19: Epic Boon
text: Gain an Epic Boon or other qualifying feat; Boon of Spell Recall suggested.

title: Level 20: Signature Spells
text: Two level 3 spells always prepared, each cast once free per Short or Long Rest.

title: Wizard Spell List
text: Wizard spells listed by level with school; C = Concentration, R = Ritual, M = Material.

title: Wizard Subclass: Evoker
text: Wizard subclass focused on blasting elemental damage spells.

title: Level 3: Evocation Savant
text: Add two free Evocation spells (level 2 or lower), plus one each new slot level.

title: Level 3: Potent Cantrip
text: Damaging cantrips that miss or are saved against still deal half damage.

title: Level 6: Sculpt Spells
text: Pick 1 + spell level creatures to auto-save and take no damage from your Evocation spells.

title: Level 10: Empowered Evocation
text: Add Int mod to a single damage roll of each Wizard Evocation spell.

title: Level 14: Overchannel
text: Max damage on a level 1-5 Wizard spell; repeat uses before a Long Rest deal you Necrotic damage.

title: Character Backgrounds
text: Backgrounds describe your life before adventuring and grant starting traits.

title: Parts of a Background
text: Intro: list of the components every background provides.

title: Ability Scores
text: Background boosts: +2 and +1 to two listed abilities, or +1 to all three; max 20.

title: Feat
text: Each background grants one set Origin feat.

title: Skill Proficiencies
text: Each background grants proficiency in two set skills.

title: Tool Proficiency
text: Each background grants one tool proficiency, set or chosen from Artisan's Tools.

title: Equipment
text: Each background offers a gear package or 50 GP instead.

title: Background Descriptions
text: Section holding the individual background entries.

title: Acolyte
text: Acolyte: Int/Wis/Cha, Magic Initiate (Cleric), Insight and Religion, Calligrapher's Supplies.

title: Criminal
text: Criminal: Dex/Con/Int, Alert feat, Stealth and Sleight of Hand, Thieves' Tools.

title: Sage
text: Sage: Con/Int/Wis, Magic Initiate (Wizard), Arcana and History, Calligrapher's Supplies.

title: Soldier
text: Soldier: Str/Dex/Con, Savage Attacker feat, Athletics and Intimidation, a Gaming Set.

title: Character Species
text: Species sets your creature type, size, Speed, and special traits.

title: Parts of a Species
text: Intro: list of the components every species provides.

title: Creature Type
text: All species here are Humanoid creature type.

title: Size
text: Species decides your size; some let you pick Small or Medium.

title: Speed
text: Species decides your base Speed.

title: Special Traits
text: Each species grants its special traits, some involving a choice.

title: Species Descriptions
text: Section holding the individual species entries.

title: Dragonborn
text: Dragonborn: Medium, 30 ft; dragon ancestry, breath weapon, damage resistance, darkvision, later flight.

title: Draconic Ancestors
text: Table: dragon color to damage type; breath weapon cone or line, Dex save, 1d10 scaling.

title: Dwarf
text: Dwarf: 120 ft Darkvision, Poison Resistance, +1 HP per level, Tremorsense on stone.

title: Elf
text: Elf: 60 ft Darkvision, choose a lineage for spells, Fey Ancestry, Keen Senses, Trance.

title: Elven Lineages
text: Table: Drow, High Elf, and Wood Elf lineage spells at levels 1, 3, and 5.

title: Gnome
text: Gnome: Small, 60 ft Darkvision, Advantage on Int/Wis/Cha saves, Forest or Rock lineage.

title: Goliath
text: Goliath: 35 ft Speed, giant ancestry boon (PB uses per Long Rest), Large Form, Powerful Build.

title: Halfling
text: Halfling: Small; Advantage vs Frightened, move through larger creatures, reroll 1s, hide easily.

title: Human
text: Human: Small or Medium; Heroic Inspiration each Long Rest, an extra skill, and an Origin feat.

title: Fiendish Legacies
text: Table: Tiefling Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal legacy resistance plus cantrip, with spells later.

title: Orc
text: Orc: Bonus Action Dash with temp HP, 120 ft Darkvision, drop to 1 HP once per Long Rest.

title: Tiefling
text: Tiefling: 60 ft Darkvision, Fiendish Legacy spells, Otherworldly Presence (Thaumaturgy).

title: Feat Descriptions
text: Feats are grouped into four categories (Origin, General, Epic Boon, Fighting Style), alphabetical within each.

title: Parts of a Feat
text: Each feat entry lists its category, any prerequisite, and its benefits; some are repeatable.

title: Origin Feats
text: Section holding the Origin feats available at character creation.

title: Alert
text: Origin feat: add Proficiency Bonus to Initiative and swap Initiative with a willing ally.

title: Magic Initiate
text: Origin feat: two cantrips plus a level 1 spell (free 1/Long Rest) from Cleric, Druid or Wizard.

title: Savage Attacker
text: Origin feat: once per turn, roll weapon damage twice and keep either result.

title: Skilled
text: Origin feat: pick any three skills or tools to become proficient in; can be taken repeatedly.

title: General Feats
text: Section heading for general feats, available from level 4 onward.

title: Ability Score Improvement
text: Level 4+ feat: +2 to one ability or +1 to two, capped at 20; repeatable.

title: Grappler
text: Level 4+ feat: +1 Str or Dex, unarmed hits can damage and grapple, Advantage against your grappled foes.

title: Fighting Style Feats
text: Section heading for fighting style feats, gained through a class Fighting Style feature.

title: Archery
text: Fighting style feat: +2 bonus on attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

title: Defense
text: Fighting style: +1 AC while you wear armour.

title: Great Weapon Fighting
text: Fighting style: on two-handed or versatile damage, any 1 or 2 counts as 3.

title: Two-Weapon Fighting
text: Fighting style: the bonus Light-weapon attack gets your ability modifier on its damage.

title: Epic Boon Feats
text: Section heading for epic boon feats, the high-level feats for level 19+ characters.

title: Boon of Combat Prowess
text: Epic boon, +1 to an ability (up to 30): once per turn a miss becomes a hit.

title: Boon of Dimensional Travel
text: Epic boon, +1 to an ability (up to 30): teleport 30 feet after an attack or a Magic action.

title: Boon of Fate
text: Epic boon, +1 to an ability (up to 30): nudge a nearby d20 Test by 2d4 up or down.

title: Boon of Irresistible Offense
text: Epic boon, +1 Str or Dex (up to 30): ignore resistance; natural 20s add extra damage.

title: Boon of Spell Recall
text: Epic boon, +1 Int, Wis or Cha (up to 30): one level 1–4 spell without a slot per long rest.

title: Boon of the Night Spirit
text: Epic boon, +1 to an ability (up to 30): vanish in shadow; resist most damage in the dark.

title: Boon of Truesight
text: Epic boon, +1 to an ability (up to 30): Truesight out to 60 feet.

title: Coins
text: Coins are the currency, priced in Gold Pieces; 100 CP make 1 GP; 50 coins weigh 1 lb.

title: Coin Values
text: Table: coin worth in gold; CP 1/100, SP 1/10, EP 1/2, GP 1, PP 10.

title: Weapons
text: Explains the Weapons table columns: Simple or Martial category, Melee or Ranged, damage, properties, mastery.

title: Weapon Proficiency
text: Anyone can use a weapon, but only proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to the attack.

title: Properties
text: Introduces the weapon properties listed in the Weapons table, defined in the entries that follow.

title: Ammunition
text: Needs ammo, one piece per shot; after a fight, a minute's search recovers half.

title: Finesse
text: Pick Strength or Dexterity for both attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

title: Heavy
text: Disadvantage on attacks unless Str 13+ (melee) or Dex 13+ (ranged).

title: Light
text: After a Light weapon attack, Bonus Action attack with a second Light weapon, no damage modifier.

title: Loading
text: A loading weapon fires once per action, bonus action or reaction, however many attacks you have.

title: Range
text: Two ranges in feet: attacks past normal range have Disadvantage; beyond long range impossible.

title: Reach
text: Extends your melee reach by 5 ft, including for Opportunity Attacks.

title: Thrown
text: Hurl it for a ranged attack, drawing it free; melee weapons keep their usual modifier.

title: Two-Handed
text: Requires both hands to attack with this weapon.

title: Versatile
text: Usable one- or two-handed; the bracketed damage applies when wielded in both hands.

title: Mastery Properties
text: Every weapon has a mastery effect, usable only if a feature like Weapon Mastery unlocks it.

title: Cleave
text: On a melee hit, strike another foe within 5 ft of it, no damage modifier; once per turn.

title: Graze
text: On a miss, the target still takes damage equal to your attack's ability modifier.

title: Nick
text: Light weapon's extra attack folds into the Attack action rather than a Bonus Action; once per turn.

title: Push
text: On a hit, shove a Large or smaller target 10 ft straight away from you.

title: Sap
text: On a hit, the target's next attack before your next turn is at Disadvantage.

title: Slow
text: Hit and damage reduces the target's Speed by 10 ft until your next turn; doesn't stack.

title: Topple
text: On a hit, target makes a Con save (DC 8 + modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or falls Prone.

title: Vex
text: Hit and damage it to gain Advantage on your following attack against it, through your next turn.

title: Weapons
text: Table: every weapon with its damage dice, properties, and mastery, grouped Simple/Martial, Melee/Ranged.

title: Armor
text: Explains the Armor table: Light, Medium, Heavy categories, base AC, Strength needs, Stealth, don/doff times.

title: Armor
text: Table: armor AC by type, from Padded 11 + Dex to Plate 18, plus Shield +2.

title: Armor Training
text: Anyone may put on armor or carry a Shield; class training decides if it works properly.

title: Light, Medium, or Heavy Armor
text: Wearing armor you're untrained in: Disadvantage on Str and Dex D20 Tests and no spellcasting.

title: Shield
text: A Shield adds its AC bonus only if you're trained with Shields.

title: One at a Time
text: You can wear just one armor suit and use one Shield at once; also armor stats table.

title: Tools
text: Explains tool entries: governing ability, Utilize options with DCs, and items you can craft.

title: Tool Proficiency
text: Proficiency adds your bonus to checks using the tool; a matching skill also grants Advantage.

title: Artisan’s Tools
text: Artisan's tools let you craft and practice a trade; each kind needs its own proficiency.

title: Other Tools
text: Section heading for non-artisan tools like kits, instruments, and gaming sets.

title: Adventuring Gear
text: Introduces the general adventuring gear list, described alphabetically with prices.

title: Adventuring Gear
text: Table: adventuring gear items with weight and cost, from Acid to Waterskin.

title: Ammunition
text: Table: ammo bundles with count, container, weight, cost; arrows and bolts 20 for 1 GP.

title: Arcane Focuses
text: Table: arcane focuses (crystal, orb, rod, staff, wand) with weight and 5 to 20 GP cost.

title: Druidic Focuses
text: Table: druidic focuses (mistletoe, wooden staff, yew wand) with weight and cost.

title: Holy Symbols
text: Table: holy symbols (amulet, emblem, reliquary), each 5 GP.

title: Mounts and Vehicles
text: Mounts speed travel and haul gear; see the animals table for carrying capacity.

title: Mounts and Cargo
text: Animals pulling vehicles haul five times their carrying capacity; team capacities add together.

title: Barding
text: Barding is mount armor: any armor type, costing 4x normal and weighing double.

title: Saddles
text: Military saddle grants Advantage to stay mounted; flying or aquatic mounts need an Exotic saddle.

title: Mounts and Other Animals
text: Table: mounts and animals with carrying capacity and cost, from Mule 8 GP to Warhorse 400 GP.

title: Tack, Harness, and Drawn Vehicles
text: Table: saddles, feed, stabling, and drawn vehicles like carts and wagons with weight and cost.

title: Large Vehicles
text: Introduces the large ship and airship statistics table and its notes.

title: Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles
text: Table: ships and airship with speed, crew, passengers, and cargo tons.

title: Lifestyle Expenses
text: Pick a lifestyle tier weekly or monthly and pay its cost to cover lodging, food, and upkeep.

title: Wretched (Free)
text: Free lifestyle: you live on luck and handouts, often sleeping exposed outdoors.

title: Squalid (1 SP per Day)
text: 1 SP per day: barest necessities, with risk of disease and petty crime.

title: Poor (2 SP per Day)
text: 2 SP per day: frugal living covering only basics.

title: Modest (1 GP per Day)
text: 1 GP per day: an ordinary, average standard of living.

title: Comfortable (2 GP per Day)
text: 2 GP per day: needs met with some small luxuries.

title: Wealthy (4 GP per Day)
text: 4 GP per day: fine living, possibly with servants.

title: Aristocratic (10 GP per Day)
text: 10 GP per day: the finest everything and staff, but your riches attract attention.

title: Food, Drink, and Lodging
text: Prices for meals and a night's lodging; daily needs already count in lifestyle costs.

title: Food, Drink, and Lodging
text: Table: costs for ale, bread, cheese, wine, meals, and inn stays by lifestyle tier.

title: Hirelings
text: Skilled hirelings use a proficiency; untrained ones do labor; listed pay is a minimum.

title: Hirelings
text: Table: skilled hireling 2 GP/day, untrained 2 SP/day, messengers 2 CP each mile.

title: Spellcasting
text: Paid spellcasting is available in settlements; add component costs; higher levels are harder to find.

title: Spellcasting Services
text: Table: spell casting price and availability by level, from 30 GP cantrips to 100,000 GP level 9.

title: Magic Items
text: Overview of the basics for finding and using magic items.

title: Identifying a Magic Item
text: Learn an item's properties via Identify or by handling it through a Short Rest.

title: Attunement
text: Some items need Attunement to unlock magic; otherwise you get only mundane benefits.

title: Wearing and Wielding Items
text: Worn items must be donned properly, weapons held; most worn items resize to fit the wearer.

title: Crafting Nonmagical Items
text: Making mundane gear needs proper tools, materials, and days of work; finished items sell at full price.

title: Tools
text: You and any helpers must be proficient with the required tool to craft the item.

title: Raw Materials
text: Materials cost half the item's price, rounded down; Plate Armor needs 750 GP of stock.

title: Time
text: Crafting days equal GP cost divided by 10 at 8 hours a day; helpers divide the time.

title: Brewing Potions of Healing
text: With Herbalism Kit proficiency, make a Potion of Healing in 1 day using 25 GP of materials.

title: Scribing Spell Scrolls
text: Spellcasters can turn a spell into a Spell Scroll using these rules.

title: Time and Cost
text: Scroll time and gold depend on spell level per the costs table; 8-hour workdays, need not be consecutive.

title: Prerequisites for the Scribe
text: Need Arcana or Calligrapher's Supplies, the spell prepared daily, and components; scroll uses your DC and bonus.

title: Cantrips
text: A scribed cantrip on a scroll scales as if cast at your level.

title: Spell Scroll Costs
text: Table: scroll days and gold by spell level, from 1 day/15 GP cantrip to level 9's 120 days.

title: Gaining Spells
text: You must have a spell prepared or available from an item to cast it; features say which.

title: Preparing Spells
text: Your spellcasting feature sets when and how many prepared spells you may swap.

title: Spell Preparation by Class
text: Table: when each class swaps prepared spells (Long Rest or level up) and how many.

title: Always-Prepared Spells
text: Spells a feature keeps always prepared don't count against your prepared spell limit.

title: Casting Spells
text: Explains spell entries; also, you can't cast while wearing armor you lack training in.

title: Spell Level
text: Spells range from level 0 (cantrips) to 9; higher level means more powerful.

title: School of Magic
text: Every spell has a school; schools are labels only, though some rules mention them.

title: Schools of Magic
text: Table: the eight schools of magic and the typical effects of each.

title: Class Spell Lists
text: Classes that can learn a spell are named in parentheses after its school.

title: Casting Time
text: Most spells take the Magic action; others need a Bonus Action, Reaction, or 1+ minutes.

title: Range
text: A spell's range is a distance in feet, Touch, or Self, limiting where effects can start.

title: Components
text: Spells need Verbal, Somatic, and/or Material components; missing any means no casting.

title: Duration
text: Spell duration is Concentration, Instantaneous, or a set time span.

title: Effects
text: A spell's effect text says exactly what it does, usually via targets, saves, or attack rolls.

title: Spell Descriptions
text: Section heading for the alphabetical list of full spell descriptions.

title: Acid Arrow
text: Ranged spell attack: 4d4 acid now and 2d4 more next turn; half the initial damage on a miss

title: Acid Splash
text: 5-ft-radius acid burst: Dex save or 1d6 acid; dice grow at levels 5, 11, 17

title: Aid
text: Up to three allies gain +5 maximum and current HP for 8 hours; +5 more per higher slot

title: Alarm
text: Ward a door, window or up to 20-ft Cube; audible or mental alert when something intrudes

title: Alter Self
text: Reshape your body: swim and breathe water, change looks, or grow natural weapons

title: Animal Friendship
text: A Beast fails a Wis save and is Charmed by you for 24 hours unless harmed

title: Animal Messenger
text: Send a Tiny Beast to carry a 25-word message to a described recipient at a known place

title: Animal Shapes
text: Transform many willing allies into Large or smaller Beasts of CR 4 or lower

title: Animate Dead
text: Raise a Skeleton or Zombie from bones or a corpse; command it with a Bonus Action

title: Animate Objects
text: Animate nonmagical objects (count set by your casting modifier) to fight as Constructs you control

title: Animated Object
text: Stat block for objects brought to life by Animate Objects: AC 15, HP by size, Speed 30 ft.

title: Antilife Shell
text: 10-ft aura keeps all creatures except Constructs and Undead from reaching or passing into it

title: Antimagic Field
text: 10-ft aura where spells, magic items and magical effects are suppressed and teleportation fails

title: Antipathy/Sympathy
text: Chosen creature kind is repelled by or drawn to a target; Wis save within 120 ft

title: Arcane Eye
text: Invisible floating eye with 30-ft Darkvision scouts for you; move it 30 ft as a Bonus Action

title: Arcane Hand
text: Large force hand (AC 20, HP equal to yours) that punches, shoves, grapples or shields

title: Arcane Lock
text: Magically lock a door or container; only chosen creatures or a password can open it

title: Arcane Sword
text: Floating force blade makes melee spell attacks for 4d12 plus your modifier; move it as Bonus Action

title: Arcanist’s Magic Aura
text: Disguise a creature's type or an object's magical aura from detection magic for 24 hours

title: Astral Projection
text: Send yourself and up to eight others into the Astral Plane, bodies left in stasis

title: Augury
text: Ask the GM whether an action within 30 minutes brings weal, woe, both or neither

title: Omens
text: Table: Augury results (weal, woe, both, neither); repeat castings before a Long Rest risk 25% no answer each.

title: Aura of Life
text: 30-ft aura: allies resist Necrotic, HP maximum can't drop, and downed allies regain 1 HP

title: Awaken
text: Give a Beast or plant Intelligence 10 and speech; it is Charmed by you for 30 days

title: Bane
text: Up to three creatures fail a Cha save and subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saves

title: Banishment
text: Cha save or the target is shunted to a demiplane; extraplanar foes may be sent home

title: Barkskin
text: Touched willing creature's AC becomes at least 17 for 1 hour

title: Beacon of Hope
text: Chosen allies gain Advantage on Wis and death saves and heal for maximum amounts

title: Befuddlement
text: Int save: 10d12 psychic and no spellcasting for a while; a success halves it.

title: Bestow Curse
text: Wis save or the touched creature suffers a curse of your choice, such as Disadvantage or extra damage

title: Black Tentacles
text: 20-ft square of tentacles: Difficult Terrain, Str save or 3d6 bludgeoning and Restrained

title: Blade Barrier
text: Wall of spinning blades gives cover; Dex save or 6d10 force when entering, half on success

title: Bless
text: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws

title: Blight
text: Con save or 8d8 necrotic, half on success; plants fail automatically or wither outright

title: Blindness/Deafness
text: Con save or the target is Blinded or Deafened for 1 minute, saving again each turn

title: Blink
text: Each turn roll 1d6; on 4 to 6 you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until your next turn

title: Blur
text: Attackers have Disadvantage against you unless they have Blindsight or Truesight

title: Burning Hands
text: 15-ft Cone of fire: Dex save, 3d6 fire or half; +1d6 per higher slot

title: Call Lightning
text: Storm cloud lets you strike a point each turn: Dex save, 3d10 lightning or half

title: Calm Emotions
text: Humanoids in a 20-ft sphere fail a Cha save and lose Charm/Fear or hostility

title: Chain Lightning
text: Bolt hits one target and arcs to three more within 30 ft: Dex save, 10d8 lightning or half

title: Charm Monster
text: Wis save or a creature is Charmed and Friendly for 1 hour; extra targets at higher slots

title: Charm Person
text: A Humanoid fails a Wis save and is Charmed and Friendly to you for 1 hour

title: Chill Touch
text: Melee spell attack: 1d10 necrotic and the target can't heal until your next turn ends

title: Chromatic Orb
text: Ranged spell attack: 3d8 of a chosen element; doubled dice let it bounce to another target

title: Circle of Death
text: 60-ft-radius sphere: Con save, 8d8 necrotic or half; +2d8 per higher slot

title: Clairvoyance
text: Place an Invisible sensor at a familiar or obvious spot and see or hear through it

title: Clone
text: Grow an inert copy of a creature; its soul moves into the clone if it dies

title: Cloudkill

title: Suggestion
text: Wisdom save or one creature follows a reasonable 25-word suggestion for up to 8 hours

title: Summon Dragon
text: Summon a Draconic Spirit ally that acts after you and obeys your commands

title: Draconic Spirit
text: Stat block for Summon Dragon's spirit: AC 14 + spell level, flies 60 ft, resists five damage types.

title: Sunbeam
text: 60-ft Line: Con save for 6d8 Radiant and Blinded, half on success; repeat as a Magic action

title: Sunburst
text: 60-ft-radius Sphere: Con save for 12d6 Radiant and Blinded 1 minute, half and no blindness on success

title: Symbol
text: Inscribe a hidden glyph that triggers a chosen harmful effect, like death, fear or sleep, in an area

title: Telekinesis
text: Magic action: move a creature (Str save) or object up to 1,000 lb by thought

title: Telepathic Bond
text: Link eight willing creatures to talk mind to mind at any distance for an hour

title: Teleport
text: Move yourself and up to eight others, or one object, to a known destination; accuracy depends on familiarity

title: Teleportation Outcome
text: Table: Teleport chance to mishap, land off target, or arrive, by familiarity with destination.

title: Teleportation Circle
text: Open a portal to a known permanent teleportation circle on your plane

title: Thaumaturgy
text: Minor wonders: booming voice, tremors, flickering flames, slammed doors, altered eyes

title: Thunderwave
text: 15-ft Cube from you: Con save for 2d8 Thunder and 10-ft push, half and no push on success

title: Time Stop
text: Act for 1d4 + 1 consecutive turns while time halts; ends if you affect others

title: Tiny Hut
text: Ritual 10-ft dome around you keeps out outsiders and spells up to level 3 for 8 hours

title: Tongues
text: Touched creature understands any language and is understood by anyone for an hour

title: Transport via Plants
text: Link a large plant to another plant you've seen; creatures step through for 5 ft of movement

title: Tree Stride
text: Step into a tree and out of another of its kind up to 500 ft away

title: True Polymorph
text: Turn a creature or object into another creature or object; permanent if held for the full hour

title: True Resurrection
text: Restore a creature dead up to 200 years with full HP, even without a body

title: True Seeing
text: Touched creature gains 120-ft Truesight for an hour

title: True Strike
text: Attack with your weapon using your spellcasting ability; may deal Radiant, adds dice as you level

title: Tsunami
text: Huge wall of water: Str save for 6d10 Bludgeoning, half on success; it sweeps forward each turn

title: Unseen Servant
text: Invisible force with AC 10 and 1 HP does simple chores at your Bonus Action command

title: Vampiric Touch
text: Melee spell attack for 3d6 Necrotic and heal half of it; repeat each turn as a Magic action

title: Vicious Mockery
text: Wisdom save or 1d6 Psychic and Disadvantage on its next attack; scales to 4d6

title: Vitriolic Sphere
text: 20-ft-radius acid blast: Dex save for 10d4 Acid plus 5d4 next turn, half initial only on success

title: Wall of Fire
text: Opaque fire wall, 60 ft long or a 20-ft ring: Dex save for 5d8 Fire; one side scorches

title: Wall of Force
text: Invisible, indestructible wall, dome or sphere of force; Disintegrate destroys it

title: Wall of Ice
text: Ice wall or dome: Dex save for 10d6 Cold; broken panels leave freezing air

title: Wall of Stone
text: Create a permanent-if-held stone wall of ten 10-ft panels that can trap or shelter

title: Wall of Thorns
text: Thorny wall blocks sight: Dex save for 7d8 Piercing, and crossing it costs extra movement and damage

title: Warding Bond
text: Ally within 60 ft gets +1 AC and saves and resists all damage, but you share its hurts

title: Water Breathing
text: Ten willing creatures breathe water as well as air for a day.

title: Water Walk
text: Up to ten creatures walk across water, mud, lava and other liquids as solid ground

title: Web
text: 20-ft Cube of sticky webs: Difficult Terrain, Lightly Obscured; Dex save or Restrained

title: Weird
text: 30-ft-radius Sphere: Wis save for 10d10 Psychic and Frightened, half on success; 5d10 per turn after

title: Wind Walk
text: You and ten allies become clouds with 300-ft Fly Speed and physical damage Resistance

title: Wind Wall
text: Wall of wind: Str save for 4d8 Bludgeoning; blocks gas, small fliers and ranged ammunition

title: Wish
text: Duplicate any spell up to level 8, or bend reality for a bigger effect at serious risk

title: Word of Recall
text: You and five allies teleport instantly to a sanctuary you prepared earlier

title: Zone of Truth
text: 15-ft-radius Sphere: Charisma save or the creature can't knowingly lie for 10 minutes

title: Glossary Conventions
text: Explains glossary tags like [Action] or [Condition] and how the rules use 'you'.

title: Rules Definitions
text: Section heading for the alphabetical definitions of game rules.

title: Ability Check
text: A D20 Test using an ability or skill to overcome a challenge.

title: Ability Score and Modifier
text: Six ability scores, each with a modifier you add to related D20 Tests.

title: Action
text: One action per turn: Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Influence, Magic, Ready, Search, Study, Utilize.

title: Advantage
text: Roll two d20s and keep the higher; doesn't stack, and cancels with Disadvantage.

title: Adventure
text: A sequence of encounters; play turns them into a story.

title: Alignment
text: Ethical outlook combining good/evil/neutral with lawful/chaotic/neutral, giving nine options.

title: Ally
text: Your party members, friends, combat allies, or anyone the GM says is on your side.

title: Area of Effect
text: Area shapes are Cone, Cube, Cylinder, Emanation, Line, Sphere, each spreading from a point of origin.

title: Armor Class
text: AC is the number attacks must meet; base is 10 + Dex modifier, use only one formula.

title: Armor Training
text: Without training: Disadvantage on Str/Dex D20 Tests and no spells in armor; untrained Shield gives no AC.

title: Attack [Action]
text: Make one weapon or Unarmed Strike attack; you may equip or stow one weapon with each attack.

title: Attack Roll
text: A D20 Test made to hit with a weapon, Unarmed Strike, or spell.

title: Attitude
text: Monsters start Friendly, Indifferent, or Hostile toward a player character, affecting Influence.

title: Attunement
text: Some magic items need a bond before they work; three bonded items at most.

title: Blinded
text: Can't see, fail sight checks; attacks against you have Advantage, yours have Disadvantage.

title: Blindsight
text: Perceive within a set range without eyes, even while Blinded, in Darkness, or against Invisible foes.

title: Bloodied
text: A creature at or below 50% of its maximum HP is Bloodied.

title: Bonus Action
text: An extra quick action on your turn, max one per turn, only when a rule grants it.

title: Breaking Objects
text: Objects take damage from attacks and spells; very fragile ones may break automatically; see AC table.

title: Object Armor Class
text: Table: object AC by material, from 11 for cloth or rope to 23 for adamantine.

title: Object Hit Points
text: Table: object HP by size, fragile or resilient; objects are immune to Poison and Psychic.

title: Bright Light
text: Ordinary illumination in which you see normally.

title: Burning [Hazard]
text: Take 1d4 Fire each turn start; use an action to drop Prone and roll it out.

title: Burrow Speed
text: Tunnel through soil, sand, mud, or ice; solid rock only with a special trait.

title: Campaign
text: A sequence of linked adventures.

title: Cantrip
text: A level 0 spell cast without spending a spell slot.

title: Carrying Capacity
text: Size and Strength set how much you carry; dragging or lifting more caps your Speed at 5 ft.

title: Carrying Capacity
text: Table: carry limit is Str x15 lb for Medium (x30 to drag/lift), scaling with size.

title: Challenge Rating
text: CR estimates a monster's threat to four characters; CR above their level means danger.

title: Character Sheet
text: The paper or digital sheet where you record your character's details.

title: Charmed
text: You can't attack or harm the charmer, who has Advantage on social checks against you.

title: Climbing
text: Climbing costs double movement (triple in Difficult Terrain) without Climb Speed; tricky surfaces may need DC 15 Athletics.

title: Climb Speed
text: Lets you climb vertical surfaces without paying the extra movement cost.

title: Concentration
text: Some effects last only while you concentrate; losing Concentration ends them; you can drop it anytime.

title: Condition
text: Conditions are temporary states with defined effects; the same condition doesn't stack on itself.

title: Cone [Area of Effect]
text: Spreads from its origin, widening so its width equals distance from the origin.

title: Cover
text: Half Cover +2 AC and Dex saves, Three-Quarters +5, Total Cover can't be targeted directly.

title: Crawling
text: Crawling costs double movement, or triple in Difficult Terrain.

title: Creature
text: Every being in the game, player characters included, counts as a creature.

title: Creature Type
text: Every creature has a type tag, like Humanoid or Undead, that other rules can reference.

title: Critical Hit
text: A natural 20 always hits; roll all damage dice twice, then add modifiers.

title: Cube [Area of Effect]
text: A cube with origin on one face; the effect gives side length; origin excluded by default.

title: Curses
text: Curse effects are defined by their source; Remove Curse or Greater Restoration can end them.

title: Cylinder [Area of Effect]
text: Origin at center of top or bottom circle; effect sets radius and height; origin included.

title: D20 Test
text: Umbrella term covering checks, attacks, and saves; the GM decides when a roll is needed.

title: Damage
text: Harm that lowers a creature's or object's Hit Points.

title: Damage Roll
text: Roll dice plus modifiers to determine how much damage you deal.

title: Damage Threshold
text: Damage below the threshold from one hit is ignored entirely; meeting it deals full damage.

title: Damage Types
text: Types are labels used by Resistance and similar rules; the table gives examples.

title: Damage Types
text: Table: the 13 damage types, Acid to Thunder, with example sources of each.

title: Darkness
text: Darkness counts as a Heavily Obscured area.

title: Darkvision
text: Within range, treat Dim Light as Bright and Darkness as Dim, seeing only grays.

title: Dash [Action]
text: Gain extra movement equal to your current Speed this turn, e.g. 30 ft becomes 60 ft.

title: Dead
text: No HP and no healing until magic like Revivify restores you; the spirit may refuse.

title: Deafened
text: Can't hear; any ability check relying on hearing automatically fails.

title: Death Saving Throw
text: Required when a player character begins their turn at 0 Hit Points.

title: Dehydration [Hazard]
text: Drinking under half your daily water gives 1 Exhaustion level, removable only by drinking fully.

title: Water Needs per Day
text: Table: daily water by size, 1/4 gallon Tiny, 1 gallon Medium, up to 64 Gargantuan.

title: Difficult Terrain
text: Moving through it costs double (it does not stack): rubble, crowds, steep ground.

title: Difficulty Class
text: DC is the number an ability check or saving throw must meet or beat.

title: Dim Light
text: Dim Light makes an area Lightly Obscured.

title: Disadvantage
text: Roll two d20s and keep the lower; doesn't stack, and cancels with Advantage.

title: Disengage [Action]
text: Your movement this turn doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

title: Dodge [Action]
text: Until next turn, attacks on you have Disadvantage and you get Advantage on Dex saves.

title: Emanation [Area of Effect]
text: Extends in all directions from a creature or object and usually moves with it; origin excluded.

title: Encounter
text: A scene built around combat, exploration, or social interaction.

title: Enemy
text: Anyone fighting or working to harm you, or anyone the GM marks as a foe.

title: Exhaustion
text: Stacks to 6 levels (death); D20 Tests minus 2 per level, Speed minus 5 ft per level.

title: Experience Points
text: XP from the GM for overcoming challenges; reaching thresholds raises your level.

title: Expertise
text: Double your Proficiency Bonus on checks with one skill you're already proficient in.

title: Falling [Hazard]
text: Take 1d6 Bludgeoning per 10 ft fallen (max 20d6) and land Prone unless unhurt.

title: Flying
text: Flyers fall if Incapacitated, Prone, or Fly Speed hits 0, unless they can hover.

title: Fly Speed
text: Lets you travel through the air and remain airborne until landing, falling, or dying.

title: Friendly [Attitude]
text: A Friendly creature likes you; you get Advantage on checks to influence it.

title: Frightened
text: Disadvantage on checks and attacks while the fear source is visible; can't move toward it.

title: Grappled
text: Speed 0, Disadvantage attacking anyone but the grappler, who can drag you at extra cost.

title: Grappling
text: Usually done with an Unarmed Strike; target becomes Grappled; needs a free hand per grapple.

title: Hazard
text: Environmental dangers: fire, thirst, hunger, falls, and lack of air.

title: Healing
text: The way you recover lost Hit Points.

title: Heavily Obscured
text: You're effectively Blinded when trying to see into a Heavily Obscured area.

title: Help [Action]
text: Grant an ally Advantage on their next check with your skill or tool, or on an attack.

title: Heroic Inspiration
text: Spend it to reroll a die you just rolled, keeping the new result; can't hold two.

title: Hide [Action]
text: DC 15 Stealth while obscured or in cover and unseen; success makes you Invisible while hidden.

title: High Jump
text: Running jump of 3 + Str modifier feet upward, half that standing; costs movement per foot.

title: Hit Point Dice
text: Hit Dice set your HP maximum and can be spent on a Short Rest to heal.

title: Hit Points
text: HP measure toughness; damage lowers them, healing restores, between 0 and your maximum.

title: Hostile [Attitude]
text: A Hostile creature dislikes you; you have Disadvantage on checks to influence it.

title: Hover
text: Hovering keeps a flying creature aloft even when it would otherwise fall.

title: Illusions
text: Illusions fool specific senses as defined by their effect; spatial ones are weightless and insubstantial.

title: Immunity
text: Damage types or conditions you're immune to don't affect you at all.

title: Improvised Weapons
text: Makeshift objects or misused weapons count as improvised; typically no proficiency and 1d4 damage.

title: Incapacitated
text: No actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions; Concentration breaks; can't speak; Disadvantage on Initiative.

title: Indifferent [Attitude]
text: Neither helpful nor hindering; the default attitude for monsters.

title: Influence [Action]
text: Roleplay urging a monster to act; GM judges willingness and whether a check is needed.

title: Influence Checks
text: Table: which check to use when influencing: Deception, Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion, or Animal Handling.

title: Initiative
text: Sets combat turn order; static score is 10 + Dex, plus or minus 5 for Advantage or Disadvantage.

title: Invisible
text: Advantage on Initiative, unaffected by sight-based effects; attacks on you have Disadvantage, yours Advantage.

title: Jumping
text: Jumps are either a horizontal Long Jump or a vertical High Jump.

title: Knocking Out a Creature
text: Drop a foe with a melee attack and choose 1 HP instead; it falls Unconscious.

title: Lightly Obscured
text: Perception checks relying on sight in a Lightly Obscured area have Disadvantage.

title: Line [Area of Effect]
text: A straight path of set length and width from its origin; origin excluded by default.

title: Long Jump
text: With a 10-ft run, leap feet equal to Strength score, half standing; rough landings need DC 10 Acrobatics.

title: Long Rest
text: 8+ hours, at least 6 asleep; restores HP and Hit Dice; 16-hour gap before the next.

title: Magic [Action]
text: Cast an action-time spell or activate a magic feature or item; long casts need it every turn.

title: Magical Effect
text: Anything produced by a spell, magic item, or a rule-labelled magical phenomenon.

title: Malnutrition [Hazard]
text: Eating under half your need: DC 10 Con save or 1 Exhaustion; 5 days without food adds Exhaustion.

title: Food Needs per Day
text: Table: daily food by size, 1/4 lb Tiny, 1 lb Small or Medium, up to 64 lb Gargantuan.

title: Monster
text: Any creature the GM runs, whether friendly or not.

title: Nonplayer Character
text: An NPC is a GM-run monster with its own name and personality.

title: Object
text: A distinct nonliving thing; larger structures like buildings are made of several objects.

title: Occupied Space
text: A space is occupied when a creature stands there or objects fill it completely.

title: Opportunity Attacks
text: When a visible foe leaves your reach, use your Reaction for one melee attack against it.

title: Paralyzed
text: Incapacitated, Speed 0, auto-fail Str and Dex saves; attacks have Advantage, nearby hits become Critical.

title: Passive Perception
text: 10 + Wisdom (Perception) bonus; the GM uses it to see if you notice things without rolling.

title: Per Day
text: Uses marked per day come back only with a Long Rest.

title: Petrified
text: Turned to stone with your gear: Incapacitated, weight x10, Resistance to all damage, immune to poison.

title: Player Character
text: A character run by one of the players.

title: Poisoned
text: You roll attacks and ability checks at Disadvantage.

title: Possession
text: The possessing effect sets the rules; a protective ward spell blocks it, Dispel Evil and Good ends it.

title: Proficiency
text: Adds your Proficiency Bonus to D20 Tests with skills, saves, weapons, or tools you're trained in.

title: Prone
text: Crawl or spend half Speed to stand; Disadvantage on attacks; close attackers get Advantage, distant ones Disadvantage.

title: Reach
text: Default reach is 5 ft, unless some rule changes it.

title: Reaction
text: An instant response to a trigger, even on another’s turn; one per round, back on your own turn.

title: Ready [Action]
text: Choose a trigger and a response; when it occurs before your next turn, act with your Reaction.

title: Resistance
text: Halve damage of that type, rounding down; applies only once per instance.

title: Restrained
text: Speed 0; attacks against you have Advantage, yours Disadvantage; Disadvantage on Dex saves.

title: Ritual
text: Cast a prepared Ritual-tagged spell with no slot by adding 10 minutes to its casting time.

title: Round Down
text: Always drop fractions after dividing or multiplying, even halves, unless a rule says round up.

title: Save
text: Shorthand for saving throw.

title: Saving Throw
text: A D20 Test to resist a threat, rolled only when a rule demands; you may choose to fail.

title: Search [Action]
text: Roll a Wisdom check to spot something hidden, using the skill suited to your goal.

title: Search
text: Table: Search skills by target: Insight for moods, Medicine for ailments, Perception for hidden things, Survival for tracks.

title: Shape-Shifting
text: Ongoing conditions and spells persist when you change form; the shifting effect defines the rest.

title: Short Rest
text: One hour of light activity with at least 1 HP; spend Hit Dice to heal.

title: Simultaneous Effects
text: When effects happen together, whoever's turn it is chooses their order.

title: Size
text: Six size categories, Tiny to Gargantuan; size sets combat space and object HP.

title: Skill
text: A specialty tied to an ability; proficiency adds your Proficiency Bonus to related checks.

title: Speed
text: How many feet you can move on your turn; special speeds include burrow, climb, fly, swim.

title: Spell
text: A magical effect following the rules laid out in the Spells chapter.

title: Spell Attack
text: Any attack roll made through a spell or other magic.

title: Spellcasting Focus
text: An item that substitutes for Material components that have no listed cost and aren't consumed.

title: Sphere [Area of Effect]
text: Radiates in all directions from its origin by a set radius; origin point included.

title: Stable
text: At 0 HP but no longer making Death Saving Throws.

title: Stat Block
text: Explains the parts of a monster stat block: size, type, alignment, AC, HP, speed, abilities, and more.

title: Study [Action]
text: Roll an Intelligence check to recall useful facts from memory, books, or clues.

title: Areas of Knowledge
text: Table: which Intelligence skill covers which topics and creature types: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, Religion.

title: Stunned
text: Incapacitated, automatically fail Str and Dex saves, and attacks against you have Advantage.

title: Suffocation [Hazard]
text: Hold breath 1 + Con modifier minutes (min 30 s); then gain 1 Exhaustion each turn.

title: Surprise
text: Caught off guard when combat starts means Disadvantage on your Initiative roll.

title: Swimming
text: Each foot swum costs 1 extra unless you have Swim Speed; rough water may need DC 15 Athletics.

title: Swim Speed
text: Lets you swim without paying the extra movement cost.

title: Target
text: Whatever is attacked, forced to save, or chosen to receive an effect.

title: Telepathy
text: Mental communication within a set range, no shared language needed by default.

title: Teleportation
text: Instant relocation without crossing the space between; uses no movement and never triggers Opportunity Attacks.

title: Temporary Hit Points
text: A buffer of extra HP from certain effects that absorbs damage before your real HP.

title: Tremorsense
text: Pinpoint creatures and things moving within range when both share a surface or liquid.

title: Truesight
text: Within range, see through Darkness, Invisibility, visual illusions, and shape changes, and into the Ethereal Plane.

title: Unarmed Strike
text: Punch or kick within 5 ft to deal 1 + Str modifier Bludgeoning, or to grapple or shove.

title: Unconscious
text: Incapacitated and Prone, drop held items, Speed 0, fail Str/Dex saves; close hits are Critical.

title: Unoccupied Space
text: A space is free if no creature is in it and objects don't fill it.

title: Utilize [Action]
text: Use this action for objects that require an action, beyond the free interaction you get.

title: Vulnerability
text: Double damage of that type, applied only once per instance.

title: Weapon
text: Any item classed as a Simple or Martial weapon.

title: Weapon Attack
text: An attack roll made using a weapon.

title: Travel Pace
text: Overland travel is Slow, Normal, or Fast; terrain sets the maximum pace allowed.

title: Good Roads
text: Traveling on a good road bumps your maximum pace up one step.

title: Slower Travelers
text: If anyone's Speed is halved or worse, the whole group must travel at Slow pace.

title: Extended Travel
text: Each hour beyond 8 needs a Con save, DC 10 + extra hours, or gain 1 Exhaustion.

title: Special Movement
text: Rules for converting high Speeds, like from Wind Walk or a flying carpet, into travel rates.

title: Vehicles
text: In a vehicle, travel at its listed miles per hour instead of choosing a pace.

title: Creating a Background
text: GM guidance for building custom backgrounds to fit a campaign or a player's story.

title: 1: Choose Abilities
text: Pick three abilities that suit the background's activities for its score increases.

title: 2: Choose a Feat
text: Give the background one Origin feat.

title: 3: Choose Skill Proficiencies
text: Pick two fitting skills; they needn't match the background's ability scores.

title: 4: Choose a Tool Proficiency
text: Pick one tool tied to the background's trade or lifestyle.

title: 5: Choose Equipment
text: Build a 50 GP starting kit, gold included, with no Martial weapons or armor.

title: Curses and
text: Section heading for the toolbox chapter on curses and magical contagions.

title: Magical Contagions
text: Intro: curses are lasting magical burdens; magical contagions are spreading magical afflictions.

title: Curses
text: Introduces the common forms curses take, detailed in the entries that follow.

title: Magical Contagions
text: Magical diseases born of alchemy or wild magic; outbreaks make good adventure hooks.

title: Environmental Effects
text: Section heading for environmental dangers like cold, heat, ice, wind, and altitude.

title: Deep Water
text: Without Swim Speed, each hour swimming below 100 ft needs a DC 10 Con save or 1 Exhaustion.

title: Extreme Cold
text: At 0°F or below, DC 10 Con save hourly or gain Exhaustion; Cold resistance auto-succeeds.

title: Extreme Heat
text: At 100°F+ without water, Con save each hour (DC 5, +1 per hour) or gain Exhaustion.

title: Frigid Water
text: Safe for minutes equal to Con score; then DC 10 Con save each minute or gain Exhaustion.

title: Heavy Precipitation
text: Area becomes Lightly Obscured, Disadvantage on Perception checks; heavy rain douses open flames.

title: High Altitude
text: Above 10,000 ft, each travel hour counts as 2 for fatigue limits unless acclimated.

title: Slippery Ice
text: Difficult Terrain; entering or starting a turn on it needs a DC 10 Dex save or fall Prone.

title: Strong Wind
text: Disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks, puts out flames, scatters fog; flyers must land or fall.

title: Thin Ice
text: Holds 3d10 x 10 lb per 10-ft square; overload breaks it, dropping creatures into frigid water.

title: Fear and Mental Stress
text: Guidance for GMs on frightening or mentally straining characters, who are tougher than ordinary folk.

title: Fear Effects
text: Supernatural terror uses the Frightened condition, resisted by a Wisdom save scaled to the scare.

title: Mental Stress Effects
text: Model intense mental strain with Psychic damage and a save; table gives sample DCs and damage.

title: Poison
text: Poisons come as Contact, Ingested, Inhaled, or Injury, each delivered in its own way.

title: Purchasing Poison
text: Poison may be illegal; acquiring it may need criminal contacts, questions, and bribes.

title: Harvesting Poison
text: From a dead or Incapacitated venomous creature: 1d6 minutes, DC 20 Nature check with a Poisoner's Kit.

title: Sample Poisons
text: Introduces example poisons, each with dose price, delivery type, and effects.

title: Traps
text: Use traps sparingly as brief obstacles; too many make players slow and overcautious.

title: Parts of a Trap
text: Explains trap entries: severity by level, trigger, duration, effects, and how to detect and disarm.

title: Example Traps
text: Introduces the alphabetical list of sample traps.

title: Combat Encounters
text: Ways to spice up fights, such as elevation changes, hazards, and varied terrain.

title: Combat Encounter Difficulty
text: Guidelines for building a fight that hits the difficulty you want.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Tips to keep in mind when designing and running combat encounters.
